prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, under a clear sunny sky. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the pristine white sand interspersed with scattered red rocks and patches of green vegetation. As the viewer progresses, the camera pans slightly to the left, revealing dense foliage and trees that line the beach, casting dappled shadows on the ground. The sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a play of light and shadow that enhances the natural beauty of the scene. The camera continues its journey, moving closer to the edge of the forest, where the sounds of rustling leaves and distant waves provide an immersive auditory backdrop. The viewer then turns right, offering a sweeping view of the expansive blue ocean meeting the horizon. The camera angle shifts subtly, showcasing the contrast between the vibrant blue water and the sandy shore. As the walk continues, the camera captures the intricate textures of the sand and rocks, emphasizing the untouched nature of this serene coastal landscape. The entire sequence maintains a consistent pace, allowing the viewer to fully absorb the tranquil and picturesque environment of Castle Rock Beach.
